versions.changelog:
- Major update: Expanded coverage for new 2024-2026 regulatory requirements and report templates.
- Added support for new capital management rules (“中国版巴三”), FATF compliance reporting, digital currency statistics, and green finance reporting.
- Updated instructions and workflows for NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, 1104, Basel III, and anti-money laundering/AML reporting.
- Provides quick-start report templates and data collection checklists tailored to updated Chinese regulatory standards.
- Improved guidance for data quality verification and error checks across key regulatory report types.
